checks.note: In-app WebGL roof-top and front-eave inspection confirms curved tapered pan tiles (about 242/221 mm mouths by 223 mm long) below curved tapered cover tiles (about 115/90 mm mouths by 222 mm long), with explicit course ends, ridge pieces, continuous mud-backed sheathing, eave boards and 210 mm rafters. Longitudinal exposure remains a user-photo visual calibration, not a measured lap.

checks.name: dailyUseDoglegStair
checks.note: The rejected straight 13-step stair was replaced by an 8+8-riser dogleg stair with daily-use going/rise proportions, an intermediate landing and continuous handrails.

checks.name: roofEnvelopeNoColorLeak
